Constructor writes the public Owner variable with the deployer address.

onlyOwner reads _owner to authorize the guarded call.
renounceOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner.

renounceOwnership clears the public Owner variable.
transferOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner.
transferOwnership assigns newOwner into the private _owner slot.
newOwner parameter is written into _owner.
Psyduck constructor calls _call() for the initial mint recipient.
Constructor mints _reflectMax into _router[deployer].
Constructor reads _reflectMax for the initial supply.
Approve is restricted to the owner via onlyOwner.
routeUniswap parameter is assigned to the caller state variable.

amount parameter is added to the minted supply figures.
